message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on parts of an automated lifting robot. The robot is an automated guided vehicle, which would fall under heading 8427 (fork-lift trucks and other works trucks fitted with lifting or handling equipment). Parts of those trucks go to 8431.20.00 ("Parts suitable for use solely or principally with the machinery of heading 8427").

Alternatively, the robot could be classified as an industrial robot under 8479.50 and its parts under 8479.90. The lift bot raises shelves (pods) and transports them, much like a Kiva drive unit. CBP has ruled on Kiva drive units as 8427.10.80 or 8427.90, "self-propelled trucks powered by electric motor," so the parts would be 8431.20.00. The statistical suffix for 8431.20.00 is 8431.20.0000 (the parts are not in the 8431.20.00 subdivided list; the 10-digit code is 8431.20.0000).

The kit would not be treated as a set under GRI 3(b), since the components are not put up together for a particular need. They would be classified individually, but all four components fall under the same 8431.20.0000 provision.
